name: Bridge sensor monitoring
description: Example dashboard; replace the source UUID and sensor schema before importing.

panels.title: Pier P2 tilt
panels.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "structure_sensors" and r._field == "tilt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sensor == "P2")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Tilt readings
panels.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "structure_sensors" and r._field == "tilt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sensor == "P2")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
